newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ interested in Venezuelan aluminium assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ interested in Venezuelan aluminium assets.

text.p: RTZ Corp-CRA Ltd said on Thursday it was interested in purchasing a controlling stake in Venezuela's state-owned aluminium sector but said the process was at a very early stage.

"A number of aluminium companies have formally expressed interest, Comalco amongst them," Comalco Ltd chairman and CRA managing director Leigh Clifford told analysts. "We have done some very preliminary work on those assets," he said.
Venezuela plans to sell a controlling stake in smelters Alcasa and Venalum, bauxite and alumina company Bauxilum and carbon anode producer Carbonorca by March 1997.
RTZ-CRA chief executive Robert Wilson told the briefing that while some preliminary work had been done "it is rather an early stage for us to be answering that one (question) right now."

Venezuela's aluminium sector has been valued by industry analysts at about US$2 billion. Thirteen companies were interested in a purchase of a stake of up to 80 percent, the daily El Nacional newspaper said on September 5.
Newspapers have recently reported interested groups include Norsk Hydro, Alcoa, Alcan, Reynolds, Kaiser, Alumax, and Marubeni Corp.
